1.0.1.en:
vailability watchdogs: set the default hours without reporting, wait a few minutes after the app starts, and require a device to stay unavailable for N seconds before it counts. New low battery check with a new "Watched device battery is low" trigger. Optional Homey timeline entries when a device goes down. Watchdogs of devices that are gone from Homey can be cleaned up in one click. All defaults are in Settings > Availability > Watchdog defaults.
New dashboard widgets: Watchdogs (filter tiles for not reporting, unavailable, low battery and OK, zone names, a Check now button) and Voltage (current reading against your configured band). The Overview widget can now list every monitor, filtered by kind, with a title of your choice. The Sentinel widget header layout is fixed.
Much lower memory use: history moved out of Homey settings into a small local database, the device list is only read when Settings or a Flow card needs it, and the app now answers Homey's memory warnings. This fixes the out-of-memory crashes seen with long histories.
Activity calibration copes with stray readings and explains why it cannot settle. Daily statistics step one calendar day at a time, so days with a daylight saving change are counted correctly.
You can edit Activity and State monitors after creating them. State groups now fire live match and mismatch triggers.
Settings page restyled with clear tabs and a dark mode."
